title: Pumpkin Kheer
description: A creamy and sweet Indian dessert made with pumpkin puree, perfect for the fall season.
instructions: Heat the ghee in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the sweet rice and sauté for 2-3 minutes until lightly toasted.
Add the pumpkin puree and stir to combine.
Cook for 5-7 minutes or until the mixture thickens.
Add the kheer and stir to combine.
Continue cooking for another 5-7 minutes or until the mixture thickens to desired consistency.
Remove from heat and stir in any additional sweetener or spices as desired.
